## Table 1. Annual event counts

Annual counts are shown by event type and sex. The current incomplete year is clearly labelled year to date (YTD).

::: {.table-responsive}

{{< include ../../../../downloads/annual/cvd/latest/tables/table_cvd_annual_01_event_counts.md >}}

:::

## Table 2. Monthly event counts

Monthly counts are shown by event type. Select a year tab; future months in the current year are shown as not available.

{{< include ../../../../downloads/annual/cvd/latest/tables/table_cvd_annual_02_monthly_counts_tabs.md >}}

## Table 3. Events among younger and older adults

Percentages show the distribution of events among people aged under 70 and those aged 70 years and over, by event type, sex and period.

::: {.table-responsive}

{{< include ../../../../downloads/annual/cvd/latest/tables/table_cvd_annual_03_age70_percent.md >}}

:::

## Table 4. Annual incidence rates

Crude and age-adjusted incidence rates are shown per 100,000 population. Select a completed year tab.

{{< include ../../../../downloads/annual/cvd/latest/tables/table_cvd_annual_04_incidence_rates_tabs.md >}}

## Table 5. Incidence rate ratios

Incidence rate ratios compare each two-year period with the 2010–2011 reference period.

::: {.table-responsive}

{{< include ../../../../downloads/annual/cvd/latest/tables/table_cvd_annual_05_incidence_rate_ratios.md >}}

:::

## Table 6. Confirmed in-hospital case fatality

Percentages describe confirmed in-hospital deaths among non-DCO hospital events.

::: {.table-responsive}

{{< include ../../../../downloads/annual/cvd/latest/tables/table_cvd_annual_06_case_fatality.md >}}

:::

## Table 7. In-hospital length of stay

Median length of stay and the lower and upper quartiles are shown by event type and sex. Select a year tab; the current incomplete year is labelled YTD.

{{< include ../../../../downloads/annual/cvd/latest/tables/table_cvd_annual_07_length_of_stay_tabs.md >}}
